project.title: Redshift calibration task force
project.summary: Prepare robust Euclid DR1 redshift distributions and prior uncertainties for weak lensing, galaxy clustering and 2D mass mapping. Compare real data, Flagship2 and SHECAL; validate calibration-sample coverage, transfer functions and the shift-and-stretch uncertainty model.
project.target_note: First estimate of DR1 N(z) prior uncertainties expected by end of November 2026. 30 November is a dashboard interpretation of the month-end target, not a separately confirmed delivery date.
project.caveats: Initial statuses reflect reports through October 2026, not live confirmations. Owners of proposed actions are suggestions unless explicitly reported. Summary dates are approximate, some threads were not read in full, and contributor totals are approximate. Personnel.txt contains names but no role descriptions. Roles here use Project_Activity.txt and technical reports, not inferred sentiment. Source spelling varies (e.g. Anna Poredon / Porredon and Olivier Illbert / Ilbert); roster spellings are retained. Channel rankings differ from the TSV (notably Marc Manera and rank 10); activity figures below use the TSV and are not a measure of responsibility or performance.

workstreams.title: Define the DR1 prior-uncertainty plan
workstreams.detail:
Set the overall plan for forward-propagating uncertainty through SOMs into N(z) realisations and final priors. 
- Resolve how simulation and real-data constraints enter the uncertainty budget.  
- Decide North/South treatment 
- Define the number of simulation realisations.

workstreams.title: Define and validate the calibration redshift sample
workstreams.owner: [zTFTz] Martine Campbell, Will Hartley, Angus Wright, Adam Stanford, Marc Manera
workstreams.detail:
Define the redshift sample. Including:
- gold/platinum spec-DB selections
- quantification of incompleteness and catastrophic failures
- testing of photo-z supplementation: 
    -> COSMOS2020 
    -> COSMOS2025 
    -> PAUS

workstreams.title: Construct final FS2 DR1-like wide samples (WL & GC)
workstreams.detail: FS2_as_DR1 shear tomographic bins reproduce data N(z) and clustering amplitude well; position samples are less well matched. Investigate pruning high-z shear bins and finalise shape/position samples for validation.

workstreams.title: Build realistic FS2 AUX / redshift mocks
workstreams.owner: Tyann Dumerchat, Francisco Castander, Angus Wright
workstreams.detail: Tyann volunteered for the Deep-mock photometric side. Francisco needs AUX photometry and error catalogues to transform FS2. Apply SSI-calibrated Deep selections (COSMOS exists; extend to CDFS). Realistic redshift-calibrator selection, incompleteness and failure rates remain the harder unresolved task; ownership of this part needs confirmation.

workstreams.title: Cross-validate SGS and CosmoPipe on SHECAL
workstreams.detail: Run data Deep/calibration samples against SHECAL wide simulations as the baseline; compare estimated N(z) with truth and SGS outputs. Use FS2 AUX catalogue-space or SSI mocks to test the impact of cross-calibration. Execution status and simulation availability need confirmation.

workstreams.title: Synthetic source injection and transfer-function tests
workstreams.detail:
DR1-like Wide, Deep and WideFromDeep mock products 
Ongoing Investigations: 
- impact of missing Deep calibrators
- impact of crowded-field shredding
- impact of systematic photometric errors. 
SSI transfer-function alternative is a validation route; pipeline adoption for DR1 is not possible.

workstreams.title: Recalibrate DataCal photometric uncertainties
workstreams.detail: Use SSI to define T_DataCalRescal, then rerun N(z) without changing the Euclid pipeline. Bright-source error underestimation is reported as the main issue, not non-Gaussianity. EXT object shot noise is absent in DR1 errors and SSI runs; planned for DR2.

workstreams.title: Test redshift-sample and completeness weighting
workstreams.owner: Angus Wright, Will Hartley, Giulia Giannini, Tyann Dumerchat
workstreams.detail: KiDS-Legacy Prior Volume weighting: Angus. DES Y3/Y6 3sDIR weighting: Will and Giulia. Compare f_c variants, cosmic variance, bias and effective sample size. Any wide-sample weighting needs consistent CS/GGL/GC/clustering-z bookkeeping. PHZ_WEIGHT use is DR2 work, not a confirmed DR1 implementation.

workstreams.title: Augment Deep SOM coverage
workstreams.owner: Dan Masters, Yu-Heng Lin, Angus Wright
workstreams.detail: Linear interpolation / inpainting of empty Deep SOM cells: Dan and Yu-Heng. Clustering SOM cells to improve coverage: Angus. Quantify changes in coverage and redshift bias before adopting a method.

workstreams.title: Match pipeline features and source selections
workstreams.detail: Additional source selections for transfer-function fidelity: Angus. SSI alternative to Yuzheng Kang's data-driven method: Tyann. Angus requested use of the actual pipeline features: unwhitened flux ratios to VIS, without amplitude.

workstreams.title: Clustering-z validation with SPHEREx and DESI
workstreams.detail: SPHEREx clustering-z validation has started; calibration-sample work awaits data permissions. Martine's documented code is private and available on request. Coordinate external checks with the final calibration sample and any selection changes.

workstreams.title: Validate shift-and-stretch priors in the likelihood
workstreams.owner: William D'Assignies, Tyann Dumerchat, Jaime Ruiz-Zapatero
workstreams.detail: Compare fitted parameters with moment-based estimates, asymmetric tails and cosmological recovery. Up to approximately 0.5 sigma biases were reported for moment statistics; inflated priors did not always recover unbiased cosmology. Request for 50-100 realisations is not an agreed requirement.

workstreams.title: Construct lens samples for shear-ratio validation
workstreams.detail: DR1 KP shear-ratio implementation needs low-z lens samples with narrow N(z), sufficient density and minimal overlap with source samples. Explore Calum's sample and Euclid plus ground photometry; use RR2 shear-ratio measurements as a comparison.

infrastructure.title: SGS pipeline
infrastructure.detail: Per-tile N_t(z) production and aggregation into tomographic N(z); WL, GC and 2DMASS only. Bias estimates with FS2 and OU-SIM/SHECAL mocks. ONLY infrastructure allowed to produce Consortium- and ESA-endorsed data products. First stacked N(z) reported June 2026.

infrastructure.title: CosmoPipe
infrastructure.detail: Direct tomographic N(z) estimation; flexible samples and extra quantity splits. Bias estimation with FS2, OU-SIM/SHECAL and synthetic source injection mocks. Agile offline validation and cross-checks; not the endorsed-product production route.

infrastructure.title: Tyann's SI infrastructure (unnamed)
infrastructure.detail: Computes redshift-distribution bias parameters from synthetic source injection. Activity file also names own-code FS2 and SI analyses.

infrastructure.title: Martine's cross-correlation infrastructure (unnamed)
infrastructure.detail: Per-tomographic-bin N(z) from spectroscopic cross-correlations with DESI and SPHEREx (sphere-X in infrastructure file). Documented private code available on request; data permissions are a dependency.

decisions.title: Endorsed data products must use SGS
decisions.detail: SGS is the sole Consortium/ESA-endorsed production route. CosmoPipe and other infrastructures provide flexible analysis and validation, not an alternative endorsement path.

decisions.title: DR1 baseline: shift-and-stretch metadata, no arbitrary N(z) correction
decisions.detail: Frozen data model allows bias/stretch metadata; arbitrary R(z) corrections to fiducial N(z) are not in scope. Hartley's final reported baseline is no bias correction, potentially subject to change. Nonzero shift-prior interpretation may require EuclidLib changes. Adequacy for tails and cosmology remains debated.

decisions.title: Use unwhitened flux ratios to VIS
decisions.detail: Align testing with pipeline colour features, without amplitude. Lupticolour/amplitude tests changed bias and bin overlap but did not improve cosmological forecasts. Request to align features is reported; completion is not.

decisions.title: Completeness cuts versus weights remain under test
decisions.detail: DR1 can define uncalibratable Wide SOM cells. PHZ_WEIGHT use is DR2 work. f_c weighting options are disputed and need consistent data-vector bookkeeping; no final threshold or variant is adopted here.

decisions.title: DR1 calibration uses COSMOS and CDFS
decisions.detail: DR1 uses these two AUX fields for calibration. Deep sample gets the Wide selection after noising. Euclid NISP spectra discussed for FORS target prioritisation, not direct calibration use.

risks.title: Calibration-sample variance and incompleteness
risks.detail: Likely dominant uncertainty: only two fields, incomplete colour coverage, calibrator abundance/quality and catastrophic redshift failures. Need first-order sample-variance correction, residual estimate and realistic mock redshift selection. Proposed mitigation: compare independent samples and propagate uncertainty through SOMs.

risks.title: Simulation fidelity and missing calibration mocks
risks.detail: FS2/Deep colour-redshift mismatch and poor low/high-z photo-z fidelity can bias calibration. SHECAL lacks a self-consistent AUX/calibration simulation baseline. Proposed mitigation: real-data cross-calibration plus SSI/FS2 AUX tests, with selection realism validated explicitly.

risks.title: Shift-and-stretch may miss asymmetric tail bias
risks.detail: Moment-derived parameters can be biased; broader priors did not always unbias cosmology. Frozen data model limits alternatives. Proposed mitigation: likelihood-consistent fits, enough realisations and explicit cosmological-recovery tests; do not assume the debate is resolved.

risks.title: Calibration and AUX catalogue access
risks.detail: Martine awaits calibration-data permissions. Hartley reports an IDR mount problem; AUX catalogues are in SWG-GAE/KP3 deep and planned for zTF photometric_cats/AUX_tiles. AUX sample selection: VIS<25.5 OR H<25.5, without VIS_DET=1. Confirm access before dependent runs.

risks.title: Photometric-error and transfer-function mismatch
risks.detail: Bright-source uncertainties underestimated; correlated noise and missing EXT shot noise affect calibration. SSI DataCalRescal is planned; EXT shot-noise inclusion is DR2. Need to measure impact on DR1 bias.

risks.title: November prior handoff has limited time and people
risks.detail: Concrete task ownership, simulation readiness and uncertainty-to-prior translation remain open. Proposed mitigation: confirm assignments and dependencies; prioritise the dominant uncertainty and stable priors over unvalidated last-minute changes.
